name: sketch-maker-benchmarks
description: Standard 12-category benchmark evaluation dataset for photo-to-procedural-art vectorization pipeline

categories.title: Clean Front-Facing Portrait
categories.description: Clean front-facing portrait with neutral studio lighting and a clean plain background.
categories.evaluationFocus: Facial landmark detection accuracy, baseline edge noise, facial symmetry, and primary contour clarity (eyes, nose, mouth, silhouette).
challengeFactors: Symmetric eye and eyebrow alignment
Subtle nose bridge and lip boundary capture without over-inking
Clean hair silhouette isolation
categories.passingCriteria: All facial landmarks aligned within 2px; zero spurious background strokes; clean stroke hierarchy from high to low priority.

categories.title: Sharp Side Profile
categories.description: Sharp 90-degree profile portrait against a neutral gradient backdrop.
categories.evaluationFocus: Profile silhouette fidelity, jawline extraction, nose tip curve accuracy, and ear structural clarity.
challengeFactors: Unilateral facial landmark detection (partial face visibility)
Nasal bridge and jawline continuity without broken fragments
Neck and turtleneck garment contour distinction
categories.passingCriteria: Continuous jawline and nose silhouette contours; absence of distorted frontal landmark illusions.

categories.title: Subject Wearing Glasses
categories.description: Subject wearing stylish dark tortoiseshell spectacles with clear glass lenses.
categories.evaluationFocus: Eye occlusion handling, frame contour vectorization vs. ocular feature retention.
challengeFactors: Eyeglass rim contours overlapping pupil/iris and eyelid edges
Lens reflection highlights without false edge artifacts
Preserving eye expression and gaze through the lenses
categories.passingCriteria: Eyeglass frames clearly delineated as distinct structural contours; pupils and eye geometry preserved beneath lenses.

categories.title: Dense Facial Hair (Beard & Mustache)
categories.description: Close portrait of a man with a dense salt-and-pepper beard and mustache.
categories.evaluationFocus: Hair-to-skin boundary separation, jawline inference beneath beard volume, mouth opening detection.
challengeFactors: Extreme high-frequency hair texture threatening to explode stroke budget
Obscured lower jawline anatomical boundary
Separation of mustache from upper lip
categories.passingCriteria: Beard treated as volumetric texture/hatching rather than thousands of chaotic micro-lines; mouth and facial expression retained.

categories.title: Hair Texture Variety (Afro / Coiled Curls)
categories.description: Portrait of a smiling woman with voluminous natural coiled afro-textured curls.
categories.evaluationFocus: High-frequency curve simplification, external silhouette boundary generation, curve budget enforcement.
challengeFactors: Thousands of micro-coils creating potential edge detector noise
Clean outer crown silhouette without losing organic hair texture
Face-to-hair boundary contrast along hairline and temples
categories.passingCriteria: Smooth outer crown silhouette with stylized representative internal curl flow; stroke count conforms to profile budget.

categories.title: Extreme Lighting & Chiaroscuro
categories.description: Dramatic cinematic chiaroscuro with intense backlight rim and deep shadow on the shadowed side.
categories.evaluationFocus: Dynamic range robustness, shadow edge filtering, backlight silhouette preservation, low-contrast feature recovery.
challengeFactors: Deep shadows obscuring facial features on the shadow side
Blown-out rim light creating stark white edges
Avoiding spurious shadow-line borders across the cheek and forehead
categories.passingCriteria: Preserves recognizable facial structure even in shadow; ignores harsh shadow demarcation lines that do not represent anatomical geometry.

categories.title: Complex Urban Background with Crowds & Foliage
categories.description: Subject smiling in a crowded, visually dense street market filled with shoppers, storefronts, and signage.
categories.evaluationFocus: Foreground subject segmentation, background suppression, clutter rejection, depth-aware masking.
challengeFactors: Dense background clutter with dozens of pedestrians and signs
Color overlap between foreground clothing and background market stalls
Maintaining crisp hair and shoulder boundaries against chaotic backdrop
categories.passingCriteria: Foreground subject completely isolated from background; background clutter suppressed according to active suppression mode.

categories.title: Noisy Low-Light Night Selfie
categories.description: Authentic night selfie illuminated by ambient street lamp with visible camera sensor ISO grain.
categories.evaluationFocus: Noise filter resilience, high-ISO grain suppression, edge confidence thresholding under poor SNR.
challengeFactors: Heavy sensor ISO noise generating false micro-edges across skin
Warm monochromatic color cast
Low contrast between face and night background
categories.passingCriteria: Gaussian/bilateral smoothing eliminates grain artifacts; no speckled or jittery micro-strokes across skin.

categories.title: Full Body Standing Pose
categories.description: Full-length portrait of a person standing upright against a studio backdrop.
categories.evaluationFocus: Whole-body anatomical proportion, limb continuity, clothing folds vs. structural silhouette, feet/shoes grounding.
challengeFactors: Small relative face scale within whole-body frame
Maintaining limb continuity through jeans and sweater wrinkles
Clean separation between shoe soles and ground floor
categories.passingCriteria: Head-to-toe anatomical hierarchy preserved; face features rendered at reduced resolution without grotesque distortion.

categories.title: Full Body Sitting Pose with Limb Occlusion
categories.description: Subject sitting on a wooden stool with crossed knees, folded arms, and beanie hat.
categories.evaluationFocus: Complex limb occlusion, joint hierarchy, self-overlapping contours, furniture separation.
challengeFactors: Arms folded across chest creating overlapping forearm and torso edges
Legs tucked upward creating knee-over-shin occlusions
Stool legs intersecting with subject footwear
categories.passingCriteria: Occlusion ordering properly layered; folded limbs remain distinct and anatomically readable.

categories.title: Multi-Person Group Portrait
categories.description: Two people standing side-by-side with touching shoulders and diverse appearances.
categories.evaluationFocus: Multi-subject instance segmentation, inter-subject boundary disambiguation, multi-face landmark tracking.
challengeFactors: Overlapping shoulders and touching silhouettes
Simultaneous landmark tracking across two faces with different skin tones and hair textures
Balanced stroke allocation between both subjects
categories.passingCriteria: Both subjects recognized with independent landmark sets; boundary between subjects cleanly distinguished without merge artifacts.

categories.title: Ultra High-Resolution 24MP+ Master
categories.description: 24-megapixel (6000x4000) portrait of an elderly person with intricate facial wrinkles, character lines, and fine silver hair.
categories.evaluationFocus: Memory limits, progressive downscaling pipeline, peak RAM monitoring, large buffer processing without browser tab crash.
challengeFactors: 24,000,000 pixel raw buffer (96MB uncompressed RGBA in memory)
Downscaling performance without aliasing or moiré patterns
Wrinkle contour filtering (preserving character lines without over-inking)
categories.passingCriteria: Downscaling pipeline successfully scales image to profile maximum (<1500ms); peak memory stays under 250MB; character lines preserved elegantly.
